primaryPagesRead.finding: Minimal browser training/prediction, setup requirements and example repository. Official task-based learning is a recurring cited pattern.
Prerequisites, source code, data handling, model training and visualized outputs. The current Tensorcraft project already supplies a comparable executable training path.
Curated visual/task tutorials and public contribution form. This is library-specific; current Tensorcraft example uses TensorFlow.js, not ml5, so no immediate submission fit established.
InferenceSession examples, backend/browser support and a linked Training on web demo. Avoid a blanket claim that ONNX Runtime Web cannot train.
Pretrained pipeline API and ONNX execution, WASM/default versus optional WebGPU. The viewed main docs differ from stable v3.8.1, so pin documentation and package versions before implementation.
Keep heuristics when appropriate, design useful metrics and preserve working pipelines. No universal 90 or 95 percent relative-accuracy switch rule.

Stephen Grider official publisher page lists algorithms from scratch, TensorFlow.js low-level work, terminal/basic-equation prerequisites and public curriculum. This directly sampled course is absent from current compare page.
